data.name: Jedediah Smith Campground - Jedediah Smith Redwoods State Park
data.description: Situated in a magnificent old-growth redwood grove on the banks of the wild and scenic Smith River, this campground offers hiking trails, swimming, fishing, and seasonal campfire programs. Cabins available. From early October to mid-May, this campground switches to "First come, first served" sites. Head to campground kiosk upon arrival to check for availability.

data.name: Mill Creek Campground - Del Norte Coast Redwoods State Park
data.description: Sleep beneath towering maples and young redwoods. Access to Mill Creek, miles of varied hiking trails, and summer programs. Located in Del Norte Coast Redwoods State Park. 7 miles south of Crescent City, CA turn east on the campground road. The camp is 2 miles east of the highway. Winter season: this campground is closed from early October to late May.

data.name: Gold Bluffs Beach Campground - Prairie Creek Redwoods State Park
data.description: Experience the wild Pacific coastline and grazing Roosevelt elk in this campground, with easy access to a secluded stretch of beach, Fern Canyon, and 70 miles of hiking and biking trails. Located on the coast within Prairie Creek Redwoods State Park in the southern part of the parks. Access is via a narrow, single lane, dirt road. Recreational vehicles are not advised, and trailers are prohibited. From early October to mid-May, this campground switches to "First come, first served" sites.
data.passportStampLocationDescription: Nearest passport stamp location is Prairie Creek Visitor Center or Thomas H. Kuchel Visitor Center.
data.reservationInfo: Reservations can be made through the California State Parks at Reserve California (1-800-444-7275).
data.regulationsOverview: The designated "Hike and Bike" backcountry site is only for those visitors that hike in, or bicycle in. It is a minimum of a 5-mile hike, or ten-mile ride to get to the site. Free backcountry permits are required for hikers intending to using the site. Visitors arriving by any motorized vehicle may not use any of the Parks' hike and bike campsites.

accessibility.rvInfo: No trailers allowed in Gold Bluffs Beach; you will be turned away if you bring one. Trailers of any kind or length are prohibited outright at Gold Bluffs Beach and on Davison Road, but it will allow RVs up to 24 ft. Please note that there are no water/electric/sewer hook ups for RVs or Motorhomes.
accessRoads: Unpaved Roads - All vehicles OK in good weather

data.name: Elk Prairie Campground - Prairie Creek Redwoods State Park
data.description: Enjoy ancient coast redwoods, grazing Roosevelt elk and black-tailed deer in Elk Prairie, easy access to over 70 miles of hiking and biking trails, and seasonal ranger-led programs. Cabins available. Located in the heart of Prairie Creek Redwoods State Park, 6 miles north of Orick, CA. From early October to mid-May, this campground switches to "First come, first served" sites. Head to campground kiosk upon arrival to check for availability.
